```{r}
daily_sensor <- read_csv("daily_sensor_readings.csv")
scouting <- read_csv("scouting_observations.csv")

sensorscout <- scouting |> 
  mutate(
    blossom_norm = (blossom_count - min(blossom_count)) /
                    (max(blossom_count) - min(blossom_count)),

    notes_penalty = case_when(
      notes_flag == "None"  ~ 0.00,
      notes_flag == "Minor" ~ 0.10,
      notes_flag == "Major" ~ 0.25,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    leaf_penalty = case_when(
      leaf_color == "Good" ~ 0.00,
      leaf_color == "Fair" ~ 0.10,
      leaf_color == "Poor" ~ 0.25,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    risk_score =
      0.45 * disease_severity +
      0.35 * pest_severity +
      0.20 * blossom_norm +
      notes_penalty +
      leaf_penalty,

    risk_level = case_when(
      risk_score < 0.30 ~ "Low",
      risk_score < 0.60 ~ "Moderate",
      risk_score < 1.00 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ "Critical"
    )
  )



sensorscout

library(readr)
write_csv(
  sensorscout, "scouting_riskScore.csv", 
  na = "NA", 
)
```

Plant risk score 

```{r}


library(tidyverse)
library(slider)

daily_sensor <- read_csv("data/daily_sensor_readings.csv")

risk_daily <- daily_sensor |>
  arrange(plot_id, date) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  mutate(
    # 7-day rolling baseline from PAST data only
    moisture_base = slide_dbl(lag(substrate_moisture), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    ph_base       = slide_dbl(lag(substrate_ph), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    ec_base       = slide_dbl(lag(substrate_ec), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_base      = slide_dbl(lag(vpd_kpa), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_base     = slide_dbl(lag(air_temp_c), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    humidity_base = slide_dbl(lag(relative_humidity_pct), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    co2_base      = slide_dbl(lag(co2_ppm), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    light_base    = slide_dbl(lag(light_ppfd), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    canopy_base   = slide_dbl(lag(canopy_temp_c), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),

    # How much today's values changed compared to the past week
    moisture_dev = abs(substrate_moisture - moisture_base),
    ph_dev       = abs(substrate_ph - ph_base),
    ec_dev       = abs(substrate_ec - ec_base),
    vpd_dev      = abs(vpd_kpa - vpd_base),
    temp_dev     = abs(air_temp_c - temp_base),
    humidity_dev = abs(relative_humidity_pct - humidity_base),
    co2_dev      = abs(co2_ppm - co2_base),
    light_dev    = abs(light_ppfd - light_base),
    canopy_dev   = abs(canopy_temp_c - canopy_base)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    across(
      ends_with("_dev"),
      ~ (.x - min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(.x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .names = "{.col}_norm"
    ),

    env_trend_risk =
      0.20 * moisture_dev_norm +
      0.15 * ph_dev_norm +
      0.15 * ec_dev_norm +
      0.15 * vpd_dev_norm +
      0.10 * temp_dev_norm +
      0.10 * humidity_dev_norm +
      0.05 * co2_dev_norm +
      0.05 * light_dev_norm +
      0.05 * canopy_dev_norm,

    index_risk =
      0.45 * plant_stress_index +
      0.35 * disease_risk_index +
      0.20 * pest_pressure_index,

    risk_score = 100 * (
      0.70 * index_risk +
      0.30 * env_trend_risk
    ),

    risk_score = pmin(pmax(risk_score, 0), 100),

    risk_category = case_when(
      risk_score < 25 ~ "No risk",
      risk_score < 50 ~ "Low risk",
      risk_score < 75 ~ "Medium risk",
      TRUE ~ "High risk"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(moisture_base)) |>
  arrange(desc(risk_score))


most_at_risk_by_day <- risk_daily |>
  group_by(date) |>
  slice_max(risk_score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(date, plot_id, risk_score, risk_category,
         plant_stress_index, disease_risk_index, pest_pressure_index)

most_at_risk_by_day


today_risk <- risk_daily |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  arrange(desc(risk_score)) |>
  select(plot_id, date, risk_score, risk_category,
         plant_stress_index, disease_risk_index, pest_pressure_index,
         env_trend_risk)

today_risk
```

```{r}
out_of_character <- daily_sensor |>
  arrange(plot_id, date) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        air_temp_c,
        relative_humidity_pct,
        vpd_kpa,
        co2_ppm,
        light_ppfd,
        substrate_moisture,
        substrate_ec,
        substrate_ph,
        canopy_temp_c,
        pest_pressure_index,
        disease_risk_index,
        plant_stress_index
      ),
      list(
        baseline = ~ slide_dbl(lag(.x), mean, .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_base  = ~ slide_dbl(lag(.x), sd,   .before = 6, .complete = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()


measure_cols <- c(
  "air_temp_c",
  "relative_humidity_pct",
  "vpd_kpa",
  "co2_ppm",
  "light_ppfd",
  "substrate_moisture",
  "substrate_ec",
  "substrate_ph",
  "canopy_temp_c",
  "pest_pressure_index",
  "disease_risk_index",
  "plant_stress_index"
)

out_of_character_long <- out_of_character |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(measure_cols),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    baseline = map2_dbl(
      measure,
      row_number(),
      ~ out_of_character[[paste0(.x, "_baseline")]][.y]
    ),
    sd_base = map2_dbl(
      measure,
      row_number(),
      ~ out_of_character[[paste0(.x, "_sd_base")]][.y]
    ),
    out_of_character_score = abs(value - baseline) / sd_base
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(out_of_character_score), is.finite(out_of_character_score))




most_unusual_today <- out_of_character_long |>
  filter(date == max(date)) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  slice_max(out_of_character_score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(out_of_character_score)) |>
  select(
    plot_id,
    date,
    measure,
    value,
    baseline,
    sd_base,
    out_of_character_score
  )

most_unusual_today
```

```{r}
alerts <- daily_sensor |>

    plant_health <= 0.50
  ) |>
  select(
    plot_id,
    farm_id,

alerts <- daily_sensor |>
  filter(
    risk_score >= 0.60 |
    plant_health <= 0.50
  ) |>
  distinct(plot_id, date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  transmute(
    plot_id,
    alert_date = date,
    health_on_alert = plant_health,
    risk_on_alert = risk_score
  )



response_effectiveness <- alerts |>
  left_join(
    daily_sensor |>
      select(plot_id, date, plant_health),
    by = "plot_id"
  ) |>
  filter(
    date > alert_date,
    date <= alert_date + days(7)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    plot_id,
    alert_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    health_on_alert = first(health_on_alert),
    risk_on_alert = first(risk_on_alert),

    avg_health_next_7_days =
      mean(plant_health, na.rm = TRUE),

    response_effectiveness =
      mean(plant_health, na.rm = TRUE) -
      first(health_on_alert),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

recovery_time <- alerts |>
  left_join(
    daily_sensor |>
      select(plot_id, date, plant_health),
    by = "plot_id"
  ) |>
  filter(date > alert_date) |>
  group_by(
    plot_id,
    alert_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    health_on_alert = first(health_on_alert),
    risk_on_alert = first(risk_on_alert),

    recovery_date =
      if_else(
        any(plant_health >= 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(date[plant_health >= 0.70], na.rm = TRUE),
        as.Date(NA)
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    recovery_days =
      as.numeric(recovery_date - alert_date)
  )


risk_reduction <- alerts |>
  left_join(
    daily_sensor |>
      select(plot_id, date, risk_score),
    by = "plot_id"
  ) |>
  filter(
    date > alert_date,
    date <= alert_date + days(7)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    plot_id,
    alert_date
  ) |>
  summarise(
    risk_on_alert = first(risk_on_alert),

    avg_risk_next_7_days =
      mean(risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),

    risk_reduction =
      first(risk_on_alert) -
      mean(risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),

    risk_reduction_pct =
      100 *
      (
        first(risk_on_alert) -
        mean(risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) /
      first(risk_on_alert),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

response_summary <- response_effectiveness |>
  left_join(
    recovery_time,
    by = c(
      "plot_id",
      "alert_date",
      "health_on_alert",
      "risk_on_alert"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(
    risk_reduction,
    by = c(
      "plot_id",
      "alert_date",
      "risk_on_alert"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    response_category = case_when(
      response_effectiveness > 0.15 &
        risk_reduction_pct > 30 ~ "Strong Response",

      response_effectiveness > 0.05 &
        risk_reduction_pct > 10 ~ "Moderate Response",

      response_effectiveness >= 0 ~ "Weak Response",

      TRUE ~ "No Improvement"
    )
  )

plot_response_summary <- response_summary |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  summarise(
    avg_response_effectiveness =
      mean(response_effectiveness, na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_recovery_days =
      mean(recovery_days, na.rm = TRUE),

    avg_risk_reduction_pct =
      mean(risk_reduction_pct, na.rm = TRUE),

    alerts_count = n(),

    strong_response_count =
      sum(response_category == "Strong Response", na.rm = TRUE),

    moderate_response_count =
      sum(response_category == "Moderate Response", na.rm = TRUE),

    weak_response_count =
      sum(response_category == "Weak Response", na.rm = TRUE),

    no_improvement_count =
      sum(response_category == "No Improvement", na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_risk_reduction_pct))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Read data
# -----------------------------

daily_sensor <- read_csv("data/daily_sensor_readings.csv")
daily_costs <- read_csv("data/daily_input_costs.csv")
plots <- read_csv("data/plots.csv")
season_summary <- read_csv("data/season_summary.csv")


daily_sensor <- daily_sensor |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

daily_costs <- daily_costs |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))




# -----------------------------
# 2. Helper normalize function
# -----------------------------

normalize <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  range_x <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (range_x == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / range_x
}


# -----------------------------
# 3. Join daily sensor + costs + plot info
# -----------------------------

risk_base <- daily_sensor |>
  left_join(
    daily_costs |>
      select(
        date, plot_id,
        daily_total_input_cost,
        daily_precision_cost,
        daily_precision_actions_count,
        daily_total_actions_count,
        daily_routine_cost
      ),
    by = c("date", "plot_id")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    plots |>
      select(
        plot_id,
        crop_plot = crop,
        treatment,
        treatment_block,
        plot_area_m2,
        plant_density_plants_m2
      ),
    by = "plot_id"
  )


# -----------------------------
# 4. Calculate plot baselines
# -----------------------------
# This lets us find what is "out of character" for each plot

plot_baselines <- risk_base |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  summarise(
    temp_mean = mean(air_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_sd = sd(air_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),

    humidity_mean = mean(relative_humidity_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    humidity_sd = sd(relative_humidity_pct, na.rm = TRUE),

    vpd_mean = mean(vpd_kpa, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_sd = sd(vpd_kpa, na.rm = TRUE),

    moisture_mean = mean(substrate_moisture, na.rm = TRUE),
    moisture_sd = sd(substrate_moisture, na.rm = TRUE),

    ec_mean = mean(substrate_ec, na.rm = TRUE),
    ec_sd = sd(substrate_ec, na.rm = TRUE),

    ph_mean = mean(substrate_ph, na.rm = TRUE),
    ph_sd = sd(substrate_ph, na.rm = TRUE),

    canopy_mean = mean(canopy_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    canopy_sd = sd(canopy_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# -----------------------------
# 5. Build daily at-risk score
# -----------------------------

daily_risk <- risk_base |>
  left_join(plot_baselines, by = "plot_id") |>
  arrange(plot_id, date) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  mutate(
    # Current biological risk
    current_risk =
      0.50 * plant_stress_index +
      0.30 * disease_risk_index +
      0.20 * pest_pressure_index,

    # 7-day trends
    stress_7d_change = plant_stress_index - lag(plant_stress_index, 7),
    disease_7d_change = disease_risk_index - lag(disease_risk_index, 7),
    pest_7d_change = pest_pressure_index - lag(pest_pressure_index, 7),

    # Only worsening trends count as risk
    stress_trend_risk = pmax(stress_7d_change, 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    disease_trend_risk = pmax(disease_7d_change, 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pest_trend_risk = pmax(pest_7d_change, 0, na.rm = TRUE),

    trend_risk =
      0.50 * stress_trend_risk +
      0.30 * disease_trend_risk +
      0.20 * pest_trend_risk,

    # Environmental anomaly z-scores
    z_temp = abs((air_temp_c - temp_mean) / temp_sd),
    z_humidity = abs((relative_humidity_pct - humidity_mean) / humidity_sd),
    z_vpd = abs((vpd_kpa - vpd_mean) / vpd_sd),
    z_moisture = abs((substrate_moisture - moisture_mean) / moisture_sd),
    z_ec = abs((substrate_ec - ec_mean) / ec_sd),
    z_ph = abs((substrate_ph - ph_mean) / ph_sd),
    z_canopy = abs((canopy_temp_c - canopy_mean) / canopy_sd),

    anomaly_score_raw = pmax(
      z_temp,
      z_humidity,
      z_vpd,
      z_moisture,
      z_ec,
      z_ph,
      z_canopy,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Cap extreme z-scores so one weird value does not destroy the scale
    anomaly_risk = pmin(anomaly_score_raw / 3, 1),

    # Response risk
    alert_risk = if_else(alert_flag == 1, 1, 0),
    no_action_penalty = if_else(alert_flag == 1 & action_taken == 0, 1, 0),
    delay_penalty = if_else(alert_flag == 1, pmin(action_delay_days / 3, 1), 0),
    failed_response_penalty = if_else(post_action_stress_delta_3d > 0, 1, 0),

    response_risk =
      0.35 * alert_risk +
      0.25 * no_action_penalty +
      0.20 * delay_penalty +
      0.20 * failed_response_penalty
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    trend_risk_n = normalize(trend_risk),

    risk_score =
      100 * (
        0.35 * current_risk +
        0.25 * trend_risk_n +
        0.20 * anomaly_risk +
        0.20 * response_risk
      ),

    risk_category = case_when(
      risk_score < 25 ~ "Low",
      risk_score < 50 ~ "Moderate",
      risk_score < 75 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ "Critical"
    )
  )


# -----------------------------
# 6. Identify main risk driver
# -----------------------------

daily_risk <- daily_risk |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    main_driver = names(which.max(c(
      "Plant stress" = plant_stress_index,
      "Disease risk" = disease_risk_index,
      "Pest pressure" = pest_pressure_index,
      "Worsening trend" = trend_risk_n,
      "Environment anomaly" = anomaly_risk,
      "Response issue" = response_risk
    )))
  ) |>
  ungroup()


# -----------------------------
# 7. Latest risk score per plot
# -----------------------------

latest_risk <- daily_risk |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  filter(date == max(date, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(
    season_summary |>
      select(
        plot_id,
        season_yield_kg_m2,
        marketable_ratio,
        season_profit_cad,
        season_roi,
        precision_benefit_cad
      ),
    by = "plot_id"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(risk_score))


# -----------------------------
# 8. Ranked table of most at-risk plots
# -----------------------------

top_risk_plots <- latest_risk |>
  select(
    plot_id,
    crop = crop_plot,
    treatment,
    risk_score,
    risk_category,
    main_driver,
    plant_stress_index,
    disease_risk_index,
    pest_pressure_index,
    alert_flag,
    action_taken,
    action_delay_days,
    season_profit_cad,
    precision_benefit_cad
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(risk_score))

top_risk_plots |> 
  slice_head(n = 15)


# -----------------------------
# 9. Plot 1: Top at-risk plots

ggplot(
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(slider)

# read data
daily_sensor <- read_csv("data/daily_sensor_readings.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# helper: normalize 0–1 safely
normalize <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (rng[1] == rng[2]) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

# calculate daily plant health first
daily_sensor <- daily_sensor |>
  mutate(
    plant_health = 1 - (
      0.50 * plant_stress_index +
      0.30 * disease_risk_index +
      0.20 * pest_pressure_index
    )
  )

# rolling 7-day risk score
plot_risk_daily <- daily_sensor |>
  arrange(plot_id, date) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  mutate(
    # past 7 days, excluding today
    past7_plant_health = slide_dbl(
      lag(plant_health),
      mean,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_plant_stress = slide_dbl(
      lag(plant_stress_index),
      mean,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_disease_risk = slide_dbl(
      lag(disease_risk_index),
      mean,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_pest_pressure = slide_dbl(
      lag(pest_pressure_index),
      mean,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_air_temp_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(air_temp_c),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_humidity_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(relative_humidity_pct),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_vpd_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(vpd_kpa),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_moisture_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(substrate_moisture),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_ec_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(substrate_ec),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_ph_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(substrate_ph),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_canopy_temp_sd = slide_dbl(
      lag(canopy_temp_c),
      sd,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    env_stability_raw =
      past7_air_temp_sd +
      past7_humidity_sd +
      past7_vpd_sd +
      past7_moisture_sd +
      past7_ec_sd +
      past7_ph_sd +
      past7_canopy_temp_sd,

    env_instability_score = normalize(env_stability_raw),

    past_health_risk = 1 - past7_plant_health,

    current_risk =
      0.50 * plant_stress_index +
      0.30 * disease_risk_index +
      0.20 * pest_pressure_index,

    risk_score_raw =
      0.40 * current_risk +
      0.30 * past_health_risk +
      0.20 * env_instability_score +
      0.10 * past7_plant_stress,

    risk_score = round(normalize(risk_score_raw) * 100, 1),

    risk_level = case_when(
      is.na(risk_score) ~ NA_character_,
      risk_score < 25 ~ "Low",
      risk_score < 50 ~ "Medium",
      risk_score < 75 ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ "Critical"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(risk_score)) |>
  select(
    date,
    plot_id,
    crop,
    risk_score,
    risk_level
  )

# save final CSV
write_csv(plot_risk_daily, "daily_plot_risk_scores.csv")

ggplot(plot_risk_daily, aes(x = date, y = risk_score, color = plot_id)) +
  geom_line()




plot_risk_daily
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(slider)

normalize <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (rng[1] == rng[2]) return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

# read files
daily_sensor <- read_csv("data/daily_sensor_readings.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

daily_costs <- read_csv("data/daily_input_costs.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

season_summary <- read_csv("data/season_summary.csv")

target_mean <- 0.75

daily_score <- daily_sensor |>
  mutate(
    raw_plot_health = 1 - (
      0.50 * plant_stress_index +
      0.30 * disease_risk_index +
      0.20 * pest_pressure_index
    ),
    
    plot_health = raw_plot_health * (target_mean / mean(raw_plot_health, na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    plot_health = pmin(plot_health, 1)
  )

daily_score |> select(plot_id, plot_health, greenhouse_id, farm_id) |> write_csv("daily_health_score_scaled_75.csv")

daily_score








# join financial data
daily_score <- daily_score |>
  left_join(
    daily_costs |>
      select(
        date,
        plot_id,
        daily_total_input_cost,
        daily_precision_cost,
        daily_routine_cost,
        daily_precision_actions_count,
        daily_total_actions_count
      ),
    by = c("date", "plot_id")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    season_summary |>
      select(
        plot_id,
        season_revenue_cad,
        total_cost_cad,
        season_profit_cad,
        season_roi,
        precision_benefit_cad
      ),
    by = "plot_id"
  )

# financial risk component
daily_score <- daily_score |>
  mutate(
    profit_at_risk = season_profit_cad * (1 - plot_health),
    profit_at_risk_n = normalize(profit_at_risk),

    daily_cost_n = normalize(daily_total_input_cost),
    precision_cost_n = normalize(daily_precision_cost),

    # higher score = better daily condition
    daily_plot_score = 
      0.40 * plot_health +
      0.25 * env_stability_score +
      0.20 * (1 - profit_at_risk_n) +
      0.15 * (1 - daily_cost_n)
  )

# scale to 0–90
daily_score <- daily_score |>
  mutate(
    daily_plot_score_scaled =
      daily_plot_score * (90 / max(daily_plot_score, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# add simple category
daily_score <- daily_score |>
  mutate(
    score_category = case_when(
      daily_plot_score_scaled >= 75 ~ "Excellent",
      daily_plot_score_scaled >= 60 ~ "Good",
      daily_plot_score_scaled >= 45 ~ "Watch",
      TRUE ~ "At Risk"
    )
  )

# final csv
daily_plot_score <- daily_score |>
  select(
    date,
    plot_id,
    crop,
    daily_plot_score_scaled,
    score_category,
    plot_health,
    env_stability_score,
    profit_at_risk,
    daily_total_input_cost,
    daily_precision_cost,
    daily_routine_cost,
    season_profit_cad,
    season_roi,
    precision_benefit_cad
  )

daily_plot_score_no_nas <-na.omit(daily_plot_score)


write_csv(daily_plot_score_no_nas, "daily_plot_score.csv")

summary(daily_plot_score$daily_plot_score_scaled)


daily_plot_score |> filter(plot_id == "P0001") |> ggplot(aes(x=date, y = daily_plot_score_scaled)) + geom_line()
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(slider)

daily_sensor <- read_csv("data/daily_sensor_readings.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

all_scores_complete <- read_csv("all_scores_complete.csv") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) 

past7_response_rate <- daily_sensor |>
  arrange(plot_id, date) |>
  group_by(plot_id) |>
  mutate(
    past7_alerts = slide_dbl(
      alert_flag,
      sum,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_actions_taken = slide_dbl(
      if_else(alert_flag == 1 & action_taken == 1, 1, 0),
      sum,
      .before = 6,
      .complete = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    past7_response_rate = if_else(
      past7_alerts > 0,
      past7_actions_taken / past7_alerts,
      NA_real_
    ),

    past7_response_rate_pct = past7_response_rate * 100
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    date,
    plot_id,
    past7_alerts,
    past7_actions_taken,
    past7_response_rate,
    past7_response_rate_pct
  )

all_scores_complete <- all_scores_complete |>
  left_join(
    past7_response_rate,
    by = c("date", "plot_id")
  )

write_csv(all_scores_complete, "data/all_scores_complete.csv")
```
